license_required.quote: Any person who shall practice or attempt to practice as a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or licensed nursing assistant in this state without a license shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3.

name.quote: "Board" means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3.

type.quote: "Board" means the New Hampshire board of nursing established in RSA 326-B:3.

umbrella_agency.value: Office of Professional Licensure and Certification
umbrella_agency.quote: certificates issued by the office of professional licensure and certification

degree_required.value: Graduate degree from an accredited APRN education program (for APRN); board-approved nursing education program (for RN/LPN)
degree_required.quote: Have graduated with a graduate degree earned in an accredited advanced practice registered nurse education program

accrediting_body.value: National accrediting body recognized by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: Receive institutional regional or national accreditation in addition to specialized nursing accreditation by accrediting bodies recognized by the United States Department of Education.

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: Nationally approved licensing examination selected by the board
exams.quote: The board shall select an appropriate nationally approved licensing examination.

interval_years.quote: All license renewals shall be issued every 2 years in accordance with RSA 310:8.

required.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

hours_per_period.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

period_years.quote: An LPN or an RN shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years.

value: For APRN: 30 hours every 2 years, 20 hours specific to specialty, 5 hours pharmacology appropriate to specialty
For LNA: 12 hours per year, at least 4 hours in medication administration if holding medication administration certificate
For CALMA: 8 hours relative to medication administration every 2 years
topical_requirements.quote: An APRN, in addition to the continuing education requirements to renew or reinstate a license as an RN, shall complete 30 hours of continuing education every 2 years, 20 hours of which shall be specific to the specialty for which renewal or reinstatement is sought, and 5 hours of which shall be training in pharmacology appropriate to the specialty

available.quote: Eligibility requirements for the issuance of all initial, temporary, and renewal licenses, specialty licenses, and certificates issued by the office of professional licensure and certification, including the issuance of such licenses to applicants holding a currently valid license or other authorization to practice in another jurisdiction.

requirements.value: Applicants holding a currently valid license or other authorization to practice in another jurisdiction must meet eligibility requirements established by board rules.
requirements.quote: including the issuance of such licenses to applicants holding a currently valid license or other authorization to practice in another jurisdiction.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person who shall practice or attempt to practice as a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or licensed nursing assistant in this state without a license shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor

credential_type.quote: Practice as a licensee without a license or when the license to do so has been revoked or suspended or when the license to do so has lapsed.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who shall practice or attempt to practice as a registered nurse, advanced practice registered nurse, licensed practical nurse, or licensed nursing assistant in this state without a license shall be guilty of a class A misdemeanor

title_protection.quote: Use, in connection with the individual's name, any designation tending to imply licensure as an RN, an LPN, or an LNA unless so licensed.

scope_protection.quote: Practice as a licensee without a license or when the license to do so has been revoked or suspended or when the license to do so has lapsed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements for licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to demonstrate the qualifications or satisfy the requirements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct that violates the security of the licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct that violates the security of the examination, including, but not limited to: Copying, disseminating, or receiving any portion of an examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convictions or pleas to a crime that relate adversely to the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Convictions by a court or any plea to a crime in any jurisdiction that relates adversely to the practice of nursing or to the ability to practice nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring a license or in filing reports, client records, or submissions to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing fraud or deceit in procuring or attempting to procure a license to practice nursing, in filing any reports or completing client records, in representation of oneself to the board or public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unethical conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or demonstrating willful or careless disregard for client health or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unethical conduct including but not limited to conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public or demonstrating a willful or careless disregard for the health or safety of a client.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a nursing or health care license denied, revoked, suspended, restricted, or otherwise disciplined in this or any other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a nurse's license to practice nursing or a multi-state privilege or another health care related license or other credential has been denied, revoked, suspended, or restricted, or the licensee has been otherwise disciplined in this or any other state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or inability to perform nursing practice with reasonable skill and safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conduct including but not limited to failure or inability to perform nursing or nursing assistant practice as defined in this chapter, with reasonable skill and safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including departure from nursing standards, improper delegation, failure to supervise, or failure to supervise student experiences.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct including but not limited to: A departure from or failure to conform to nursing standards, including improper management of client records.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a chief administrative nurse to follow appropriate standards in overseeing nursing organization and services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a chief administrative nurse to follow appropriate and recognized standards and guidelines in providing oversight of the nursing organization and nursing services of a health care delivery system.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to practice within a modified scope of practice or with required accommodations as specified by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to practice within a modified scope of practice or with the required accommodations, as specified by the board in granting a modified license under this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any nursing practice that may create unnecessary danger to a client's life, health, or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any nursing practice that may create unnecessary danger to a client's life, health, or safety. Actual injury to a client need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety due to illness or mental or physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice safely, including demonstration of actual or potential inability to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to clients by reason of illness or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsifying records, failure to cooperate with board investigation, failure to maintain professional boundaries, abuse or mistreatment of clients, sexual conduct with clients, or threatening behavior.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Actions or conduct that include, but are not limited to, falsifying reports, client documentation, agency records, or other essential health documents, failure to cooperate with a lawful investigation conducted by the board, failure to maintain professional boundaries with clients or family members, use of excessive force upon or mistreatment or abuse of any client, engaging in sexual conduct with a client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion or attempts to divert drugs or controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion or attempts to divert drugs or controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensee to comply with terms of any alternative program agreement made with the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensee to comply with terms of any alternative program agreement made with the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances, drugs, or alcohol to an extent dangerous to self, others, or the public, or that impairs ability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance or any drug or device or alcoholic beverages to an extent or in a manner dangerous or injurious to himself or herself, any other person, or the public, or to the extent that such use may impair his or her ability to conduct with safety to the public the practice of nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in the practice of nursing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding, assisting, advising, or allowing an unlicensed person to engage in the practice of nursing.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a board rule, board order, state or federal law relating to nursing, or state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a rule adopted by the board under RSA 541-A, an order of the board, a state or federal law relating to the practice of nursing, or a state or federal narcotics or controlled substance law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the scope of practice as stated in the chapter and failing to report violations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing beyond the scope of practice as stated in this chapter, and failing to report violations of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Upon notification by another jurisdiction's licensing authority that a licensee has been disciplined.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Upon notification by the licensing authority of another jurisdiction that a licensee has been disciplined.

definition_quote.value: Nursing means assisting clients or groups of clients to attain or maintain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and by evaluating responses to nursing care and medical treatment.
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing" means assisting clients or groups of clients to attain or maintain optimal health by implementing a strategy of care to accomplish defined goals and by evaluating responses to nursing care and medical treatment.

value: Developing and implementing plan of care
Managing, supervising, and evaluating nursing practice
Selecting, administering, and providing therapeutic measures and treatment regimes (APRN)
Prescribing and dispensing controlled and non-controlled drugs (APRN)
methods_authorized.quote: Performing acts of advanced assessment, diagnosing, prescribing, selecting, administering, and providing therapeutic measures and treatment regimes

drug_authority.value: APRNs have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute controlled and non-controlled drugs within scope of practice, including schedule II-IV controlled drugs via telemedicine.
drug_authority.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice as defined by this chapter.

license_tiers.quote: "Nurse" means a person authorized to practice nursing and who holds a current license to provide care as an APRN, RN, or LPN.

aprn_role_categories.quote: "Advanced practice registered nurse" or "APRN" means a registered nurse currently licensed by the board under RSA 326-B:18.

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: An LPN shall, with or without compensation or personal profit, practice under the supervision of an RN, APRN, licensed physician, or dentist.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice as defined by this chapter.

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice as defined by this chapter.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: An APRN shall have plenary authority to possess, compound, prescribe, administer, and dispense and distribute to clients controlled and non-controlled drugs within the scope of the APRN's practice as defined by this chapter.

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs may prescribe opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV via telemedicine; when prescribing via telemedicine, a subsequent in-person exam must be conducted at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: When prescribing a non-opioid or opioid controlled drug classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine a subsequent in-person exam shall be conducted by a practitioner licensed to prescribe the drug at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually.

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The office shall maintain a registry of nursing assistants who qualify pursuant to 42 C.F.R. section 483.156.

medication_assistant_certification_avail.quote: "Certified assisted living medication aide" or "CALMA" means an individual who is certified by the office of professional licensure and certification to administer specific classes of and routes of medication

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A nurse holding a currently valid license as an RN or an LPN may delegate specific nursing activities and tasks under the circumstances, and in accordance with the constraints, set forth in rules of the board adopted under RSA 541-A.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Every individual, agency, facility, institution, or organization that employs licensed nursing personnel within the state shall report to the board within 30 days any action by a licensee that willfully violates any provision of paragraph II.

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: No person may coerce an RN or an LPN into compromising client safety by requiring the nurse to delegate a nursing activity or task when the nurse determines that it is inappropriate to do so. A licensee shall not be subject to disciplinary action for refusing to delegate or refusing to provide training related to such delegation when the licensee has determined that such delegation may compromise client safety

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The nurse licensure compact is adopted and entered into with all other jurisdictions that legally join the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The office of professional licensure and certification shall contract with other organizations to operate the alternative recovery monitoring program for licensees who are impaired by substance use disorder or mental or physical illness.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: APRNs may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV via telemedicine after establishing an APRN-patient relationship. A subsequent in-person exam must be conducted at intervals appropriate for the patient, medical condition, and drug, but not less than annually. Out-of-state APRNs providing services via telemedicine must be licensed in NH.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An APRN licensed under this chapter may prescribe non-opioid and opioid controlled drugs classified in schedule II through IV by means of telemedicine after establishing an advanced practice registered nurse-patient relationship with the patient.

military_education_credit_required.quote: The implementation of strategies and criteria necessary to increase the acceptance of military training and experience towards licensure for military veterans seeking to be licensed as a nurse.
